sources: Mind's Eye Theatre: Laws of the Reckoning (WW05037), Creeds table p.86 (the seven regular creeds) and The Lost Creeds p.87 (Deviance, Isolation); every entry read directly from the book's own page images, per reference-wod-scan-ocr-lessons.

The design's own citation of a "Camp" identity field was not found anywhere in this book on a fresh read - dropped rather than invented. "Handle" is real: the book's own opening fiction names a hunter-net alias ("chemist105", p.83), and the hunter-net FAQ (p.265-267) confirms hunters routinely use one to identify each other online.

fields.name: Creed
fields.note: Deviance and Isolation are the book's own "lost creeds" (p.87) - not available to a player without explicit Storyteller permission.

fields.name: Handle
fields.note: The hunter's own hunter-net alias, if any.
